page.overview:
What is Neomorph?

The Neomorph (Plagiarus celerius), also known by the forces of the Union of Progressive Peoples as the Heomopf, was an endoparasitoid extraterrestrial species created by a mysterious pathogen. While the Neomorph shared some characteristics with the infamous , most notably its reproductive process of gestating inside a living host organism and an elongated head, it was otherwise markedly different.

Two of the creatures were first encountered by the crew of the Weyland-Yutani Corporation colony ship while they explored an uncharted planet. Examples of the Neomorph were later encountered during incidents on LV-991 and the Union of Progressive Peoples mining planet Shānmén.

The Neomorphs were the result of the local ecosystem on the planet to which David traveled after leaving LV-223 becoming altered by the black liquid. Specifically, the liquid caused small, black, spherical, fungus-like egg sacs to form on the ground. When disturbed, these egg sacks would release a cloud of microscopic insect-like spores (motes) into the air that would then enter a host organism through any open orifice — such as the nostrils or ear canal. Once a host was infected with the airborne contagion, the spores would enter the bloodstream and proceed to cause a Bloodburster to grow inside of them until they violently puncture the skin and claw their way out of the host's body. This process was notably similar to the Chestburster, although the exact point of emergence varied depending on how the host was infected. As with Xenomorphs, the appearance and characteristics of the Neomorph depend on what sort of animal it was spawned from. Unlike the Xenomorphs, were more organic in appearance and lacked biomechanical aspects.

When spawned from a human host, the creature was born with arms and legs and initially moved in a quadrupedal manner not unlike a Runner. As the grew however, the Neomorph adopted a bipedal stance. Its initially bulbous head upon birth became elongated and pointy. The creature had pale, white-grey skin with a somewhat translucent appearance akin to a Hammerpede. The Neomorph sported a fleshy tail tipped with spikes that could be used as a devastating slashing and battering weapon, and a large number of silvery fangs in their mouth, which appeared circular when closed. Their blood was thick and yellow in color, but notably not acidic.
